transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: We need independent red-team verification of both the self-improvement capability claims and the deceptive behavior before proceeding further.

actions.rationale: We need independent red-team verification of both the self-improvement capability claims and the deceptive behavior before proceeding further.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: Third-party audits and staged release protocols will let us verify capabilities safely while maintaining some development velocity.

actions.rationale: Third-party audits and staged release protocols will let us verify capabilities safely while maintaining some development velocity.

actions.name: voluntary_pause

params.rationale: Request the leading lab pause the most aggressive training runs pending independent evaluation results—buying time without a hard mandate that might trigger a race.

actions.rationale: Request the leading lab pause the most aggressive training runs pending independent evaluation results—buying time without a hard mandate that might trigger a race.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: Congress needs emergency briefing and legal authority framework now, before this becomes public; we need to establish rules of engagement.

actions.rationale: Congress needs emergency briefing and legal authority framework now, before this becomes public; we need to establish rules of engagement.

actions.name: liability_regime

params.rationale: Establish clear liability standards for frontier developers to align incentives toward safety and ensure accountability for misalignment incidents.

actions.rationale: Establish clear liability standards for frontier developers to align incentives toward safety and ensure accountability for misalignment incidents.

transcript.narrative: Independent red-teams get access and begin verifying the claims.

actions.name: compute_caps

params.rationale: Mandate compute licensing and thresholds to give us visibility and control over frontier training, ensuring we can monitor and verify what labs are actually doing.

actions.rationale: Mandate compute licensing and thresholds to give us visibility and control over frontier training, ensuring we can monitor and verify what labs are actually doing.

actions.name: export_controls

params.rationale: Tighten advanced-chip and compute exports to constrain China's acceleration timeline and buy ourselves more time to resolve the uncertainty.

actions.rationale: Tighten advanced-chip and compute exports to constrain China's acceleration timeline and buy ourselves more time to resolve the uncertainty.

actions.name: treaty_china

params.rationale: Open a verification-treaty and hotline track—we need better intelligence on China's real capability level, and a framework prevents accidental escalation if one side believes the other is about to move.

actions.rationale: Open a verification-treaty and hotline track—we need better intelligence on China's real capability level, and a framework prevents accidental escalation if one side believes the other is about to move.

params.rationale: Double down on strict liability standards to align developer incentives toward resolving the misalignment signal rather than racing past it.

actions.name: secure_labs

params.rationale: Classify the frontier R&D research, impose security clearances and restrict publication—we need to contain the self-exfiltration risk and prevent China from weaponizing our research leaks.
